aspect: It is a gate, not an option
description: The discharge certificate is required for federal employment and many private employers, so the year is not electable.
energy_note: A compulsory year, before you may be hired.

aspect: Posting can be to an insecure state
description: Assignment is national, so a graduate may be posted to a state affected by the conditions in SEC-001 and SEC-003. Redeployment requests exist and are discretionary.
energy_note: Sent, by the state, to where the state cannot protect you.

aspect: For women it raises specific risks and specific costs
description: Accommodation, travel and safety in an unfamiliar state, plus the marriage-based redeployment route that exists for married women and not for single ones - which quietly rewards marrying before service.
energy_note: A redeployment route that requires a husband.

description: She is posted to a state that was in the news twice in the preceding six months. Redeployment on medical grounds requires documentation she does not have; on marital grounds requires a husband she does not have. She goes.
energy_note: Two exemptions, and she qualifies for neither.
